note: Vendor calls and reactions (context = vendor type, or 'any'). Adults only. 1974 prices match content/vendors.json.

lines.text: Hot dogs! Hot dogs here! Red hot and still warm!
Franks! Kraut, onions, the works! Thirty-five cents!
Mustard's free. Advice is a nickel.
Don't lean on the umbrella, it's older than you.
Pretzels! Hot pretzels! Salt or no salt!
Knishes! Potato, kasha! Hot like your mother made!
A pretzel's a meal if you believe in yourself.
Ices! Lemon ice! Cherry! Cold, cold, cold!
Rainbow's fifty cents. Three flavours, one heat wave.
Hot nuts! Honey roasted! Smell that? That's free!
Cashews, seventy-five. Peanuts, fifty. The smell, on the house.
Coffee, regular! Roll and butter! Keep it moving!
Regular means milk and sugar, pal. This is New York.
Peaches! Jersey peaches! Sweet as a lie!
Carnation for your lapel, sir? Twenty-five cents for a better day.
Ticker! Dispatch! Get your Ticker! It's all in there!
Read it here, you buy it. This ain't the library.
Shine, mister? Fifty cents. Walk out new.
Watches. Gold. Practically gold. Twenty-two karat for ten bucks.
Umbrellas! Two dollars! It's raining, you need me!
Sunglasses, three bucks. Look like a movie star. A cheap one.
Find the lady, find the lady! Follow the red, win the bread!
Easy money! Watch close! Who's got a sharp eye today?
Cops! Fold it! Fold it, go, go!
Hey! You hit my cart! That's my whole day on the street!
Get down! Get behind the cart! Get down!
Watch where you're driving, you maniac! I got a permit!
Permit's on the cart, officer. Same permit as yesterday.
Business is like the weather. It's terrible and I'm still out here.
Somebody's selling on my corner again. Thirty years, my corner.
Ten a week, they want now. Ten a week to stand on a sidewalk.
